```{r}
#| label: cvevents
cvevents <- function(tbl, when, what, where, descr) {
  command_start <- "\\cvevent"
  tbl[[where]] <- gsub("\n", " \\\\newline ", tbl[[where]])
  res <- paste0(
    command_start, "{", tbl[[when]], "}", 
    "{", tbl[[what]], "}",
    "{", tbl[[where]], "}"
  )
  cat(res, sep = "\n\n\n")
}

```

# Profile

Data Scientist translating complex 
high-dimensional biomedical data into actionable 
insights. Expert in building reproducible analytical 
pipelines (R, Docker, GitHub, Quarto) and open-source tools.
 Proven track record of guiding researchers from experimental design to publication-ready 
 figures and code sharing.

# Experience

\cvevent{02/2025 - Present}{Senior R Developer}{Cytel for Johnson \& Johnson}

-   -- Advise and consult research laboratories on the selection of statistical methodologies and technology stacks for high-dimensional biomedical data analysis, particularly for clinical efficacy and oncology endpoints

-   -- Develop, document, and maintain reproducible reporting pipelines (Quarto, R Markdown) deployed via containerized environments (Docker/CI-CD)

-   -- Build reusable, open-source R packages to standardize and accelerate data processing workflows across multiple research teams

-   -- Design, performance testing, and maintenance of analytical infrastructures (Posit Server) hosting applications in a strictly regulated environment

<br>


\cvevent{01/2024 - 02/2025}{Data Science Consultant}{Freelance - Pharmaceutical \& Tech}

-   -- Led end-to-end biomedical data projects, translating researcher requirements into scalable architecture and reproducible deployment

-   -- Developed high-performance custom R containerized apps integrating rigorous unit testing: See \href{https://ecocalc.eu/}{\underline{here}} for the Chemical Intelligence Platform

<br>


\cvevent{03/2023 - 01/2024}{Data Scientist}{FlowBank}

-   -- Architected and deployed a comprehensive data science environment for the internal data team, standardizing reproducible workflows (Docker, Git) and analytical tools

-   -- Analyzed high-frequency datasets to develop and maintain machine learning pipelines for trade anomaly and fraud detection

-   -- Developed custom internal R packages and containerized Shiny applications, enabling business teams to interactively explore complex multivariate data

<br>


\cvevent{03/2023 - Present}{Key Contributor \& Developer}{Opifex}

-   -- **echarts4r (R and JavaScript):** Lead maintainer, high-impact visualization package. Widely adopted across the R community for generating complex, interactive charts for research groups.

-   -- **fiRebase (R and JavaScript):** Lead maintainer, enabling secure backend integrations for interactive web applications.

<br>


\cvevent{03/2020 - 01/2022}{PhD Candidate in Computational Neuroscience}{Novo Nordisk \& University of Geneva}


-   -- Architected an HPC cluster (Slurm) to optimize parallel analytical workflows on bare hardware

-   -- Engineered Linux servers and storage architecture to securely process high-dimensional biomedical data

-   -- Provided statistical support for experimental design and hypothesis validation

-   -- Analyzed high-dimensional biological datasets (fMRI/ERP) via signal processing, sparse matrices, and clustering

-   -- Ensured research reproducibility by maintaining traceable analytical pipelines (Git, Docker, R Markdown)

-   -- Supported peer-reviewed publications with high-quality data visualizations (ggplot2) and open-source code

<br>
<br>
<br>


\cvevent{09/2020 - 01/2022}{Asssistant Lecturer in Biostatistics}{UniGe - Neuroscience Master}

-   -- Taught introductory biostatistics and led practical workshops in R

-   -- Created and maintained course materials

<br>
